'''Reinforced shield generators''' were a model of [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generator]] which increased the power of [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shields]] or [[Particle shield/Legends|particle shields]]. They were available in the period following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].
